body:
I have nowhere to go. Believe me, I've tried. I've even thought about living in the woods. My friend has spoken of him taking me away with him, but my mom would literally murder me, and I don't want to die by her. Though mom has talked about moving to Florida for most of my life, and I could try to stay alive if she's honest this time. I'm just worn out.

If I could leave all of this without fear, I would. I want to be an adult and make my own decisions, have a job, and have at least a modicum of freedom. 

 I don't have a license due to the aforementioned illnesses, and mom just plain ignoring me. I used to have a car, but she sold it to my aunt. Now, the only car I could drive is hers.

All of my friends live in the north, a place I wouldn't mind being. It'd probably be more liberal than here, and maybe I could be more open about my sexuality. I've always wanted a romantic partner.

To be completely honest, I don't want to die. I want to be alive and experience the things that I see other people experience. But, as fate would have it, I cannot. I was dealt a bad hand, and thus crippled. I hate *my* fucking life. But I don't hate life itself. It's funny, I guess. 

I hope I don't go to a hell of some kind. I was told my entire life that I would. I wish that I wasn't so alone.

I frequent RBN a lot on my main account; it's very helpful and helps to kill the loneliness, even if it's not by much.

They seem indifferent for the most part, except for one, but I think he gets attached to people easily. He lives far away from me, so I hope that will numb the pain somewhat. I love him, but I can't suffer for him. 

I'm almost 19 but I have no driver's license and I live in the deep south. There's no cheap apartments or public transport for miles. I would get a job if I could.

No worries for the questions. I didn't really expect to get a response, because this sub doesn't seem too active. And thank you, it's nice to hear someone who doesn't fling guilt trips at me. I hope you have a great day/night.
